youtube.title: Zoomy's Road Trip ABC: K to O! (POP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🚗 POP! Zoomy the car hit a bump, the trunk popped open and all the letter blocks flew out! Can you help Zoomy find them?

Drive along with Zoomy and learn the letters K, L, M, N and O! Each letter block comes back one by one with a word that starts with it: K is for kite, L is for leaf, M is for moon, and more. Zoomy's road trip goes up in the sky, through the forest, under the moon and down to the ocean! Then sing the letter song with Zoomy, and stay till the end, because someone on the farm wants to learn the next letter! 🐷

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn the letters K, L, M, N and O
✔️ Hear a word for each letter (K is for kite!)
✔️ Practice early phonics and letter sounds
✔️ Sing a catchy driving letter song with Zoomy!
